title: DNS: use pinfo->pool instead of wmem_packet_scope where possible
description:
`wmem_packet_scope` is deprecated, we should use `pinfo->pool` now.

This commit only converts the "easy" parts of `packet-dns.c`
where a `pinfo` variable was already available.
For `get_dns_name` it will need adding an allocator parameter
and updating ~60 function calls (including in other dissectors),
in which I might find that I *also* don't have easy access to a `pinfo`,
so I'm leaving that one for later....
